description_en: Gets the workflow drafts that were recently updated or created by the current user
description_zh: 获取当前用户最近更新或创建的工作流草稿
kebab_example: aliyun paistudio list-recent-experiments --order DESC --source PaiStudio --type Modified --workspace-id 86995 --page-number 2 --page-size 20 --api-version 2021-02-02 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRecentExperiments

parameters.description_en:

- ASC: ascending order.
